gui.flash.guide.pick: Click a hero to see how to get it.
gui.flash.guide.flash.1: Craft the Transformation Chamber and the Potion Container and place the container next to the chamber.
gui.flash.guide.flash.2: In the container: a Potion of Swiftness I, of Regeneration I and of Strength I.
gui.flash.guide.flash.3: Step into the chamber (right click) and power it with redstone. Lightning strikes and the Speed Force is yours.
gui.flash.guide.flash.4: Another way: someone who is the Flash takes the power out with an empty syringe and you inject the capsule.
gui.flash.guide.hulk.1: Craft the Gamma Capsule, the Gamma Reactor and the Gamma Chamber (the reactor goes in the chamber's recipe).
gui.flash.guide.hulk.2: Click the Gamma Chamber with the capsule, step on the pad and click with an empty hand.
gui.flash.guide.hulk.3: Stay inside until the radiation ends: you are the Hulk for good.
gui.flash.guide.hulk.4: The Gamma Capsule in a syringe only gives a temporary Hulk (5 min).
gui.flash.guide.red_hulk.1: Someone who is the (green) Hulk takes the power out with an empty syringe: the Gamma Essence Capsule.
gui.flash.guide.red_hulk.2: Put the capsule in the Processor powered by redstone: 10 s of blue, purple, magenta and white lightning.
gui.flash.guide.red_hulk.3: Out comes the Red Gamma Essence Capsule: take it with an empty hand, load a syringe and inject.
gui.flash.guide.red_hulk.4: Doing it again with the red capsule turns it green again.
gui.flash.guide.superman.1: Find a Crashed Kryptonian Ship in the world (rare).
gui.flash.guide.superman.2: In the ship's chest: 5 Kryptonian Cells (and sometimes the Kryptonian Baby, which gives the power when eaten).
gui.flash.guide.superman.3: Put the 5 cells in the Processor powered by redstone: out comes the Kryptonian Blood.
gui.flash.guide.superman.4: Drag the capsule onto an empty syringe and inject (hold right click).
gui.flash.guide.thor.1: Become worthy: the two advancements below.
gui.flash.guide.thor.2: Once worthy, search the world for the crater where Mjolnir fell like an asteroid.
gui.flash.guide.thor.3: Click the Mjolnir stuck at the bottom of the crater: only the worthy can lift it.
gui.flash.guide.thor.village: Hero of the Village: win a raid
gui.flash.guide.lex.1: No powers needed: it is equipment.
gui.flash.guide.lex.2: Craft the 4 pieces (iron, emerald, redstone block and amethyst).
gui.flash.guide.lex.3: Wear the 4 pieces: the suit powers up and the helmet interface shows.
gui.flash.guide.lex.4: Charge the battery on the Armour Stand powered by redstone.

gui.flash.yas.dialog.title: Guardian of the Transcendence
gui.flash.yas.dialog.text: Few come this far, above the clouds. Who transcends leaves the limits of common powers behind. But who tries unprepared does not come back.
gui.flash.yas.dialog.question: Do you wish to transcend?
gui.flash.guide.yas.1: Conquer every hero of the mod (list below).
gui.flash.guide.yas.2: Carry a capsule of each power and the 4 pieces of Lex's suit:
gui.flash.guide.yas.3: Find the Island of the Transcendence, floating at Y=200 (very rare), and talk to the Guardian.
gui.flash.guide.yas.4: Accept to transcend. If anything is missing, you die in 3 seconds.
gui.flash.theme.yas.title: Yas · Transcendence
gui.flash.theme.yas.subtitle: Beyond the limits of common powers
gui.flash.yas.about1: Who transcended on the floating island leaves the limits of common powers behind: the Sun and the Moon, time, reality and matter obey her hand.
gui.flash.yas.about2: Each power is a combat mode: Alt + scroll changes mode (or click a mode here) and R uses the mode's ability (Shift gives the area variants). In Temporal mode, R marks and rewinds, Z speeds up time. The powers reach players too.
gui.flash.yas.about3: Double jump flies, faster than Superman at level 10. Never takes fall damage. Regeneration I always, III near death.
gui.flash.yas.about4: Holding someone with Telekinesis, scroll to bring them closer or push them away. Diving from Y=200 or higher she burns like a meteor: the higher, the bigger the impact. The syringe keeps her essence, which only she can inject.
ability.flash.yas.flight.description: Double jump flies. Sprint speeds up, double-tap sprint for the boost: faster than Superman at level 10.
ability.flash.yas.toughness.description: Takes a fifth of the damage Superman at level 10 would (5× tougher) and is not knocked back.
ability.flash.yas.punch.description: The empty-hand punch is 1.5× Superman's at level 10.
gui.flash.yas.cfg.lightning.desc: The white and yellow lightning running over the body (everyone sees it).
gui.flash.yas.cfg.eyes.desc: The white glowing eyes (everyone sees them).
key.flash.yas.variant: Yas: variant of the mode (speed up time)
ability.flash.yas.regen.description: Regeneration I all the time; near death (2 hearts or less) Regeneration III.
